prompts.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create a premium ultra-photorealistic studio product render of a single space-black MacBook Pro laptop, full device visible, centered near-front view with extremely slight elevation so a thin strip of keyboard is visible behind the front lip. Input image is the EXACT screen content to display, a Korean SPECTRA music taste map screenshot. Preserve the source screenshot layout, all album-art discs, Korean header, controls and overall spatial map faithfully; do not invent redesigned UI. Use the full screenshot edge to edge within the active display without cropping. Fit naturally in 16:10 screen. Reference composition is a near-frontal open laptop product cutout. Premium anodized dark aluminum with subtle brushed microtexture, precision chamfered rim with fine silver edge highlights, physically plausible screen glass, hinge and front finger recess. Lid open ~100 degrees. Camera like high-end Apple catalog, 85mm product lens, clear crisp geometry with no exaggerated wide-angle distortion. Large display occupies most of the product, simple low flat base. Controlled large softbox highlights, faint lavender and cyan rim accents consistent with screenshot, no bright reflections obscuring UI, sharp screen. Realistic proportions and thickness. Absolutely transparent background alpha, no solid backdrop, no floor, no added type, no arrows, no extra floating elements, no watermark. Keep entire laptop including all corners and base in frame with 6% safe margins. Highest available native resolution, landscape composition around 3:2, meticulously detailed product photograph quality.
